title: Text: DET Rick Anderson ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Andy.. I’m coming off vacation and I need to write a column about Doug getting fired, essentially

I don’t know him all that well but I think he’s read at least some of what I wrote, which is why I got a call last week. My question to you is (obviously no quotes or anything like that), but is he a straight-up guy? I may only get one side of the story with this
